title: Oversize Openings and Crew-Day Counting — Installation Jobs
content:
**Oversize openings in crew-day counting — Installation Jobs**

The oversize openings recorded at the latest completed measure of the **Window Replacement Contracts** contract an **Installation Jobs** record installs decide how the job's crew days are counted. The count is the oversize openings on the most recent measure visit of that contract with a completed outcome; a door job, or a contract whose completed measure records no oversize opening, has none.

## Counting rule

1. **4 or more oversize openings.** The units the crew plans for, other than the oversize openings, are divided by the daily pace and rounded up to whole days; the oversize openings are set on days of their own at 2 a day, rounded up to whole days; and the two day counts are added.
2. **1 to 3 oversize openings.** Each oversize opening counts as one and a half units (1.5), and the units the crew plans for, so weighted, are divided by the daily pace and rounded up to a whole day.
3. **No oversize opening.** The units the crew plans for are divided by the daily pace and rounded up to a whole day.

## Worked examples (hypothetical inputs, daily pace 5)

| Units the crew plans for | Oversize openings | Counting | Crew days |
|---|---|---|---|
| 20 | 5 | 15 other units at 5 a day give 3 days; 5 oversize at 2 a day give 2.5, rounded up to 3; 3 plus 3 | 6 |
| 20 | 2 | 18 ordinary units plus 2 oversize at 1.5 each give 21 weighted units; 21 divided by 5 is 4.2, rounded up | 5 |
| 20 | 0 | 20 divided by 5 | 4 |
| 12 | 4 | 8 other units give 1.6, rounded up to 2; 4 oversize at 2 a day give 2; 2 plus 2 | 4 |
